note: Batch 4 Extra Hard 正式候选 E-0086~E-0100（对应矩阵 §7.2 EH 行的 10 场景配额）与备选池 D-0032~D-0041。全部 gold_sql 只读；嵌套子查询/窗口函数/条件聚合/多维分组/CTE 自联结均基于 db/ecommerce.db（seed=20260914）固定日期口径，真实执行核验。销售/金额/销量类排除 cancelled，字段语义（total_amount vs subtotal/quantity）逐题核对。

candidates.question: 累计消费金额超过全平台用户平均累计消费2倍、且累计下单超过8笔的用户有哪些？（请给出用户名、累计金额、订单数与购买商品种数）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH user_stats AS (SELECT o.user_id AS uid, SUM(o.total_amount) AS spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS sku_cnt FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.user_id) SELECT u.username, ROUND(us.spent, 2) AS total_spent, us.orders, us.sku_cnt FROM user_stats us JOIN users u ON u.id = us.uid WHERE us.spent > 2 * (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM (SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS spent FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY user_id) t) AND us.orders > 8 ORDER BY us.spent DESC, u.id
candidates.notes: 三表 JOIN(users×orders×order_items)=multiple_join；嵌套子查询（AVG over 用户聚合）作 2 倍比较基准（comparison_to_average）；多业务条件组合。

candidates.question: 销量高于其所属叶子分类平均销量的商品中，销量最高的10款商品是哪些？（请给出商品名、分类名与销量）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH prod_sales AS (SELECT p.id, p.name, p.category_id, c.name AS cat_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id) SELECT ps.name, ps.cat_name, ps.sold FROM prod_sales ps WHERE ps.sold > (SELECT AVG(d.sold) FROM (SELECT p2.id, SUM(oi2.quantity) AS sold FROM products p2 JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.id JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = oi2.order_id WHERE o2.status != 'cancelled' AND p2.category_id = ps.category_id GROUP BY p2.id) d) ORDER BY ps.sold DESC, ps.id LIMIT 10
candidates.notes: 四表 JOIN+相关嵌套子查询（分类内平均商品销量，comparison_to_average）+Top-10。全量 248 款，取 Top-10 合理。

candidates.question: 2025年销售金额最高的5款商品中，它们上半年与下半年的销售额分别是多少？（请给出商品名、上半年额、下半年额与全年额）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT p.name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) <= '06' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END) AS h1, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) >= '07' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END) AS h2, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id, p.name) SELECT name, ROUND(h1, 2) AS first_half, ROUND(h2, 2) AS second_half, ROUND(total, 2) AS total FROM sales ORDER BY total DESC, name LIMIT 5
candidates.notes: SUM(CASE WHEN...) 条件聚合拆分上下半年（conditional_aggregation+case_when），多表 JOIN，全年 Top-5。

candidates.question: 销售金额高于全部分类平均销售金额的叶子分类有哪些，并给出它们占全平台总销售金额的比例？（请给出分类名、销售额与占比百分比）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH cat_sales AS (SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS sales FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name) SELECT name, ROUND(sales, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(sales * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(sales) FROM cat_sales), 2) AS pct FROM cat_sales WHERE sales > (SELECT AVG(sales) FROM (SELECT sales FROM cat_sales)) ORDER BY revenue DESC
candidates.notes: 四表 JOIN+嵌套子查询（分类均值比较，comparison_to_average）+占比 ratio（子查询分母）。

candidates.question: 2025年各订单状态下，实付金额高于5000元的高金额订单数与5000元及以下的普通订单数分别是多少？（含取消订单的结构统计）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(CASE WHEN total_amount > 5000 AND status != 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) AS high_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN total_amount <= 5000 AND status != 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) AS normal_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
candidates.notes: COUNT(CASE WHEN...) 条件聚合双口径统计；cancelled 计入 total_cnt（结构统计）但不在金额档内（金额口径）。

candidates.question: 2025年各收货地区、各季度的平均实付金额（客单价）是多少，每个组合的订单量如何？（仅列订单数不少于10的地点-季度组合）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT o.region, CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01','02','03') THEN 'Q1' WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('04','05','06') THEN 'Q2' WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07','08','09') THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region, quarter HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY o.region, quarter
candidates.notes: 地区×季度多维分组（multi_dimension_grouping）+CASE WHEN 季度（date_group）+HAVING 样本量过滤。

candidates.question: 2025年下半年实付销售额高于上半年、且增长幅度最大的是哪些收货地区？（请给出地区、上半年额、下半年额与增长百分比）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH region_sales AS (SELECT o.region, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) <= '06' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS h1, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) >= '07' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS h2 FROM orders o WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region) SELECT region, ROUND(h1, 2) AS first_half, ROUND(h2, 2) AS second_half, ROUND((h2 - h1) * 100.0 / h1, 2) AS growth_pct FROM region_sales WHERE h2 > h1 ORDER BY growth_pct DESC, region
candidates.notes: SUM(CASE WHEN...) 条件聚合分上下半年+增长 ratio；半年维度比较（comparison 语义）。

candidates.question: 2025年各收货地区中，销售金额最高的3个商品分类分别是哪些？（请给出地区、分类与销售额，按地区与名次排列）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH region_cat AS (SELECT o.region, c.name AS cat_name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region, c.id, c.name), ranked AS (SELECT region, cat_name, revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rk FROM region_cat) SELECT region, cat_name, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue FROM ranked WHERE rk <= 3 ORDER BY region, rk
candidates.notes: 四表 JOIN+地区×分类多维分组+窗口函数 ROW_NUMBER 分组内 Top-3（每地区前3类）。

candidates.question: 2025年各月的非取消订单实付销售额与2024年同月相比的同比增速是多少？（请给出月份、2024年销售额、2025年销售额与同比百分比）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y', order_date) AS yr, strftime('%m', order_date) AS mo, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY yr, mo) SELECT m.mo AS month, ROUND(p.revenue, 2) AS revenue_2024, ROUND(m.revenue, 2) AS revenue_2025, ROUND((m.revenue - p.revenue) * 100.0 / p.revenue, 2) AS yoy_pct FROM monthly m JOIN monthly p ON p.mo = m.mo AND p.yr = '2024' WHERE m.yr = '2025' ORDER BY m.mo
candidates.notes: CTE 自联结（两年同月对齐）Compute 同比增速 ratio；date_group 月度维度。

candidates.question: 最近30天（2026年8月14日至9月12日）中，有哪些地区-分类组合的销售金额高于该地区各组合的平均销售金额？（请给出地区、分类与销售额，取前10）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH pair_sales AS (SELECT o.region, c.name AS cat_name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-08-14' AND o.order_date <= '2026-09-12' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region, c.id, c.name HAVING SUM(oi.subtotal) > 30000) SELECT ps.region, ps.cat_name, ROUND(ps.revenue, 2) AS revenue FROM pair_sales ps WHERE ps.revenue > (SELECT AVG(t.avg_rev) FROM (SELECT region, AVG(revenue) AS avg_rev FROM pair_sales GROUP BY region) t WHERE t.region = ps.region) ORDER BY ps.revenue DESC, ps.region, ps.cat_name LIMIT 10
candidates.notes: 四表 JOIN+30天窗+地区×分类多维分组+相关嵌套子查询（地区内组合均值比较，comparison_to_average）+HAVING 组合金额过滤。

candidates.question: 2025年环比增速最快的3个月份是哪几个？（请给出月份、当月销售额与环比增速百分比）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY month), with_prev AS (SELECT month, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_rev FROM monthly) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND((revenue - prev_rev) * 100.0 / prev_rev, 2) AS mom_pct FROM with_prev WHERE prev_rev IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mom_pct DESC, month LIMIT 3
candidates.notes: 窗口函数 LAG 环比 + ratio 增速 + date_group 月度 + Top-3。

candidates.question: 2025年中，商品销售金额高于全国地区平均销售金额、且订单笔数也高于全国地区平均订单笔数的区域有哪些？（请给出地区、销售额与订单数）
candidates.gold_sql: SELECT o.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region HAVING SUM(oi.subtotal) > (SELECT AVG(v.revenue) FROM (SELECT region, SUM(oi2.subtotal) AS revenue FROM orders o2 JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi2.order_id = o2.id WHERE o2.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o2.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o2.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o2.region) v) AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) > (SELECT AVG(w.orders) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o3.id) AS orders FROM orders o3 JOIN order_items oi3 ON oi3.order_id = o3.id WHERE o3.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o3.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o3.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o3.region) w) ORDER BY revenue DESC, o.region
candidates.notes: 双条件嵌套子查询（地区销售额均值与地区订单均值两个比较基准，comparison_to_average）+HAVING 双指标过滤；subtotal 口径排除 cancelled。

candidates.question: 每个商品分类中，销量最高的3款商品分别是哪些？（请给出分类、商品名与销量；仅统计销量超过50的商品）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH cat_prod AS (SELECT c.name AS cat_name, p.name AS prod_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, p.id, p.name HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) > 50), ranked AS (SELECT cat_name, prod_name, sold, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cat_name ORDER BY sold DESC) AS rk FROM cat_prod) SELECT cat_name, prod_name, sold AS sold_qty FROM ranked WHERE rk <= 3 ORDER BY cat_name, rk

candidates.question: 哪些收货地区中，家用电器类目销售金额占该地区总销售金额的比例高于全平台家电占比？（请给出地区、家电销售额与占比百分比）
candidates.gold_sql: WITH total AS (SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total_rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region), elec AS (SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS elec_rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND c.name = '家用电器' GROUP BY o.region) SELECT e.region, ROUND(e.elec_rev, 2) AS elec_rev, ROUND(e.elec_rev * 100.0 / t.total_rev, 2) AS pct FROM elec e JOIN total t ON t.region = e.region WHERE e.elec_rev * 100.0 / t.total_rev > 24.97 ORDER BY pct DESC, e.region
candidates.notes: 双 CTE（地区总额/地区家电额）+类目占比 ratio（子查询分母，分子分母同口径 subtotal 排除 cancelled）；与全平台家电占比 24.97% 比较。

candidates.question: 2025年5月（传统促销月）与2月（淡季）相比：两个月的非取消订单销售额分别是多少，订单量分别是多少，5月销售额相当于2月的多少倍？
candidates.gold_sql: WITH may AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(total_amount) AS rev FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-05-01' AND order_date <= '2025-05-31' AND status != 'cancelled'), feb AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(total_amount) AS rev FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-02-01' AND order_date <= '2025-02-28' AND status != 'cancelled') SELECT ROUND(m.rev, 2) AS may_revenue, m.cnt AS may_orders, ROUND(f.rev, 2) AS feb_revenue, f.cnt AS feb_orders, ROUND(m.rev / f.rev, 2) AS may_to_feb_ratio FROM may m, feb f
